description: Comprehensive recursive project ecosystem analysis with advanced prompting techniques (Knowledge Generation + Reflexion)

analysisScope.description: Specific analysis areas to focus on (e.g., ["security", "performance", "architecture", "dependencies"])

enhancedMode.description: Enable advanced prompting features (Knowledge Generation + Reflexion)

includeEnvironment.description: Automatically include comprehensive environment analysis (default: true)

includePatterns.description: File patterns to include in analysis

knowledgeEnhancement.description: Enable Knowledge Generation for technology-specific insights

learningEnabled.description: Enable Reflexion learning from past analysis outcomes

projectPath.description: Path to the project directory to analyze (optional, uses configured PROJECT_PATH if not provided)

technologyFocus.description: Specific technologies to focus analysis on (auto-detected if not provided)

name: analyze_project_ecosystem
